method.rows: effects with Expected difference == Positive, one per (paper, experiment, effect)
method.internal_replications: pooled by fixed-effect inverse-variance meta-analysis of the internal replications' SMD (the dataset's Meta-analysis columns include the original and are used only for criterion 5); paper 9 experiment 1 has no numeric data and is combined by majority vote of per-row codes
method.direction_and_significance: RP:CB categorical codes: SMD-based column when the effect has a replication SMD, else the original-test column; 'Null' (no difference, no test) counts as failure
method.ci_criteria: SMD columns (per-effect scale: SMD, or HR / r where RP:CB did not convert)
method.spearman: original SMD (Cohen's d, dz, Glass' delta only) vs 0/1 success, Fisher-z CI with SE 1.06/sqrt(n-3)
